sections.heading: Description of Property Insured
sections.body: Building including plinth and foundation of the workshop and administrative block; plant and machinery including slipway winches, overhead cranes and dredge pump test rigs; stocks of spares, cutter heads, pipelines and consumables; furniture, fixtures and office equipment, all situated at the location of risk stated in this schedule. Floating craft and vessels afloat are excluded.

sections.heading: Perils Covered
sections.body: Fire; lightning; explosion or implosion; aircraft damage; riot, strike and malicious damage; storm, cyclone, typhoon, tempest, hurricane, tornado, flood and inundation; impact damage; subsidence and landslide including rockslide; bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus and pipes; missile testing operations; leakage from automatic sprinkler installations; bush fire. Earthquake (fire and shock) and terrorism are covered by add-on endorsements attached hereto.

sections.heading: Excess and Special Conditions
sections.body: An excess of 5% of each and every claim subject to a minimum as per the policy wordings shall apply to all perils other than fire. Reinstatement value basis applies to buildings and plant and machinery. The insured shall maintain fire hydrant and portable extinguisher systems in working order and shall notify the insurer of any material alteration in occupancy or construction.

sections.heading: Claims Intimation
sections.body: In the event of any loss, intimate the Visakhapatnam policy servicing office immediately and in any case within 7 days, quoting the policy number. Toll free claims helpline: 1800-209-5577 (fictional). Email: claims.vizag@konkansurety.example

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, write to the Grievance Officer at the registered office or email care@konkansurety.example. If not resolved within 15 days, you may approach the Bima Bharosa portal of IRDAI or the Insurance Ombudsman having jurisdiction. This schedule is to be read with the policy wordings and endorsements, which form part of this contract.
